_comment: The total large load interconnection queue, as ERCOT states it in published text. DATA, NOT CODE: a new figure is a data commit with its source, never an edit to a renderer. Kept here rather than in the collector's ledger because it comes from a different document on a different cadence than the Monthly Operational Overview, and blending the two would hide that.
source_title: ERCOT Update, Senate Committee on Business & Commerce
quote: ERCOT is tracking approximately 410 GW of Large Loads seeking interconnection of which ~87% are data centers.
